title: Moves for your screens
what: Six ways to show a screen or an idea, built in your colors. Click a card to play it. Keep the ones that feel like you.
next: Next: where you sit on screen.
head: <script>window.playClip=function(id,el){var v=el.querySelector("video");if(v){v.currentTime=0;v.play();}};window.playClipStop=function(id,el){var v=el.querySelector("video");if(v){v.pause();}};</script>

options.name: Screen floats in
options.line: A page floats in space, tilted; a light sweeps across it. Good for: introducing a tool.
options.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#1d2430"><g transform="translate(80,40) skewY(-8)" opacity="1"><rect width="160" height="95" rx="4" fill="#252e3c" stroke="#8a94a6" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="6" y="6" width="64" height="5" rx="2" fill="#F2B33D"/><rect x="6" y="16" width="148" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a94a6"/><rect x="6" y="23" width="112" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a94a6"/></g><path d="M120 30 L170 30 L120 150 L70 150 Z" fill="#fff" opacity=".08"/></svg><video src="clips/m1.mp4" poster="clips/m1.jpg" preload="metadata" muted playsinline style="position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover"></video>

options.name: Fly through the steps
options.line: The camera flies past each step in a row of screens. Good for: showing a process.

options.name: Cards stack in depth
options.line: Screens sit behind each other; focus moves from back to front. Good for: before and after.

options.name: Tools on a ring
options.line: Cards circle one center, the one that matters turns to face you. Good for: how tools connect.

options.name: Push into the screen
options.line: The camera pushes into one card until it fills the frame. Good for: going into detail.

options.line: A big title flies in, turns and catches a glint. Good for: episode or chapter title.
